newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tele-Com rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tele-Com rated buy.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst Frederick Moran said stocks of cable television operators "have bottomed out, and that the outlook for the industry should improve."
-- sees cable TV as the "most technologically sophisticated means of transmission of broadband communications services...now is the time for investors to begin establishing investment positions..."
-- initiated coverage of Tele-Communications Inc as buy and aded to the recommended list, and started Comcast Corp as buy, and added it to the recommended list.

-- initiated the following stocks as neutral: Adelphia Communications Corp ; Cablevision Systems Corp ; Century Communications Corp ; Cox Communications Inc ; Jones Intercable Inc ; TCA Cable TV Inc ; and U S West Media Group.
